items.prompt: Can a PSD sample covariance fail to be PD?

options.why: Strict positive versus nonnegative forms differ.

options.text: Only if some diagonal entry is negative

options.text: Yes; exact feature collinearity can make it singular
options.why: A nonzero direction can have zero variance.

options.text: No; increasing decimal display precision guarantees PD
